messages:
maria (Product): Heads up — AcmeCorp reported model drift hitting their production evals. They want a clear deprecation + canary cadence we can commit to in the contract (they're asking for 90 days total notice). We need a pragmatic policy that satisfies contracts but keeps our rollout velocity. :eyes:

alex (Eng-ML): Quick thought: make this a 3-stage flow: NOTICE (60d), CANARY (14d), FINAL SWITCH/PIN (16d) = 90d. During CANARY route 5% traffic to new model variant with regressions monitored. Benchmarks to gate the CANARY: latency p95 < 120ms, embed cosine-delta < 0.02, generation quality (BLEU/ROUGE-ish proxy) within 1.5 pts of baseline. If any gate fails, auto-roll back and notify.

sam (SRE): Ops note — continuous 5% canary is OK but autoscaling + KV cache priming will spike tokens for certain seq lengths. We'll need a short warmup (2–4h) for KV caches and an autoscaler tweak: target_cpu -> target_gpu_util shift for canaries. Also add a fallback route to previous pinned model for the customer.

jules (Solutions Eng): For enterprise customers we should offer an "extended gracepath" opt-in: +30/60 day optional hold for major customers during which we provide a migration runbook and dedicated support hours. Also add an in-console toggle so customer success can delay the final pin for approved accounts.

ben (Legal): From contracts POV we need: (1) explicit definition of "deprecation notice" and how it's delivered, (2) the deprecation effective date (we typically use the first business day after the last notice window), and (3) compatibility-shim clause — if we ship a shim or adapter we need SLA carveouts. I'll draft language but need the exact windows to insert.

alex (Eng-ML): Proposed canary config snippet for ops & contracts: ```
canary:
  notice_days: 60
  canary_days: 14
  final_grace_days: 16
  canary_traffic_pct: 5
  gates:
    - name: latency_p95
      threshold_ms: 120
    - name: embed_cosine_delta
      threshold: 0.02
    - name: gen_quality_delta
      threshold: 1.5
```

sam (SRE): Ops caveat: make the canary window min 24h for telemetry stability, otherwise noise will trigger false rollbacks. Recommend canary_days >= 14 but require at least `min_observation_hours: 24` in config.

maria (Product): Good flagged points. Action items: alex = canary plan + gate definitions (RFC by Thu), sam = infra checklist and autoscaler changes (PR for config), jules = customer comms + in-console toggle UX (mock by next Mon), ben = contract wording (draft by EOD Fri). I'll add a roadmap ticket RDW-1234 and a customer-visible comms template. Everyone ok with owners? :thumbsup:

jules (Solutions Eng): 👍 will add migration checklist: data export steps, evaluation harnesses, rollback playbook, and a customer dry-run template.

ben (Legal): 👍 I'll include the effective-date language and a short FAQ entry about gracepath options.

alex (Eng-ML): One more: add a metric for "semantic drift" beyond embeddings — run a small eval suite on customer prompts daily during canary and report a single drift score (0..1). We'll set action at >0.3.

sam (SRE): noted. I'll add `min_observation_hours` and `semantic_drift_score` to infra schema.

deploy-bot: Canary config created for RDW-1234 by alex — status: pending infra PR. :rocket:
